title: WebhookEndpoint
description: An endpoint for a webhook registered under a specific app.

id.description: The optional unique identifier for this endpoint.

uid.description: Mapping to the external ID of the endpoint.

external_id.description: The ID of this webhook from the external system.

description.description: The friendly description for this endpoint.

secret.description: The endpoint's verification secret. If null is passed, a secret is automatically generated. Format: base64 encoded random bytes optionally prefixed with whsec_. Recommended size: 24.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the address

date_created.description: The time and date that this endpoint was created

date_modified.description: The time and date that this endpoint was modified

url.description: The url for this endpoint to send websocket events to

filter_types.description: The types of events to filter, leave empty to receive all events.

channels.description: List of message channels this endpoint listens to (omit for all)

rate_limit.description: The rate limits for this project
